Latest posts

  • B2B PartnershipsOctober 28, 2026

    Distributor, reseller or agent: which US route to market fits your product?

    Each one carries a different share of the stock, the risk and the customer. The right choice depends on how American buyers expect to buy in your category.

  • AI Solutions DevelopmentOctober 28, 2026

    Where should a small team start with workflow automation?

    Start with one task your team repeats often, that follows clear rules and that does little harm when it goes wrong. Map it, automate the predictable steps and keep a person on the decisions.
